tagline: The chart that keeps every handoff under one pathway
audience: care pathway leads and clinical operations at health systems

features.name: Stage map
features.description: Five named stages on one spine so Intake cannot pretend Discharge is optional

features.name: Handoff beads
features.description: Citeable transfers between stages — who received the chart, and when

features.name: Dwell windows
features.description: Time-on-stage drawn under each node so a quiet bottleneck cannot hide

features.name: Encounter ladder
features.description: Rounds read as Enc 01–n with notes that travel while the ward decides

features.name: Chart imprint
features.description: Edition and ward stamped so a reused pathway cannot orphan its provenance

features.name: Pathway memory
features.description: A chart that survives the jump from triage to discharge without becoming orphan notes

constraints: clinical teal not violet or cream-terracotta
